criteria.text: An allowed simulation subtree permits only the selected complete in-bound source; selection forms and repository-relative reference meanings stay unchanged.
A required excluded file refuses before authentication, network, model metadata or dispatch and names the referring chain, requested target, boundary and remedy.
The same ceiling covers includes, recursive dependencies, test context, calls, contract and seed references, app maps, stylesheets and preparation inputs and outputs.
Excluded optional discovery and footprint files are not opened or a reason to refuse independent selected work; incomplete footprints cannot establish a current pass.
For stable source, --files names the actual upload paths and sizes; separate non-upload reads are disclosed, and a changed capture snapshot is retried consistently.
Existing unconfigured behavior, secret, regular-file, symlink and ancestor, size and stricter write or executable safeguards remain in force.
